name: Yellow-bellied Tyrannulet
rangeDescription: Humid lowlands of southern mexico (oaxaca) to northeastern costa rica
description: A tiny, stub-tailed flycatcher of humid tropical forest. Spends most of its time in the canopy, where overlooked easily, but at times descends lower, mainly at forest edges.

name: Tanimbar Megapode
rangeDescription: Tanimbar islands (banda sea)
description: A large, dull-colored partridge-like bird with powerful legs and feet, an obvious crest, and pink facial skin. Shy.

name: Gorgeted Sunangel
rangeDescription: Andes of southwestern colombia (nariño) and northwestern ecuador
description: Unmistakable; glittering pinkish-purple throat is distinctive in good light, but also note the snowy white chest band, which is always obvious. Medium-sized with a rather short, straight bill.

name: Rufous-fronted Parakeet
rangeDescription: Central andes of western colombia (tolima and cauca)
description: Plump parakeet found only at very high elevations in Colombia’s central Andes, where it is quite scarce. Plumage is nearly all green; the tiny patches of orange on its face and chin are only evident when the bird is seen well.

name: Stresemann's Bush-Crow
rangeDescription: Southern ethiopia (sidamo province)
description: An unusual small crow-like bird with gray, black, and white plumage. There is bright blue bare skin around the eye, and sometimes a small pink patch is also visible behind the eye.

name: Squacco Heron
rangeDescription: Locally in southern palearctic region, and africa and madagascar
description: Small stout heron; favors freshwater marshes, lakes, and ponds with reeds and other surrounding vegetation. Tends to hunt rather sluggishly, hunched quietly at the edge of the water.

name: Seram White-eye
rangeDescription: Seram (southern moluccas)
description: A small green-backed songbird with a bold white eye-ring, a black face, a yellow throat, a white belly, and a yellow base to the undertail. Occurs in forest and nearby secondary growth in lowlands and foothills, sometimes in small groups.

name: Timor Heleia
rangeDescription: Lowlands of western timor (eastern lesser sundas)
description: A rather distinctive small green songbird with a yellow face, a bold black line through the eye, black scalloping on the crown, and streaked light yellow underparts. Juveniles plainer, with little or no streaking on crown and underside.
imageCreditName: Lars Petersson | My World of Bird Photography

name: Manus Cuckooshrike
rangeDescription: Admiralty islands (manus and los negros)
description: Learn about White-bellied Cuckooshrike (Manus): explore photos, sounds, and observations collected by birders around the world.
imageCreditName: Lars Petersson | My World of Bird Photography

name: Rimatara Reed Warbler
rangeDescription: Rimatara (tubuai islands)
description: A large warbler with a yellowish eyebrow and a dark eye-stripe. Crown and upperparts warm olive-brown.

name: Slaty-backed Flycatcher
rangeDescription: Himalayas (nepal to northern myanmar and southwestern china); winters to southeastern asia
description: Slender flycatcher of hilly and montane forests. Male is slate blue-gray above and orange below; it is duller and darker than male blue flycatchers and lacks the wingbars of the stockier male Mugimaki Flycatcher.

name: Southern Martin
rangeDescription: Bolivia to uruguay and argentina; winters to north to colombia
description: Large swallow with pointed wings and slightly forked tail. Males are deep iridescent purple; females are also entirely dark, but are brownish below, with faint scaling.

name: Nicaraguan Grackle
rangeDescription: Lake nicaragua, lake managua, and northern costa rica
description: Long-tailed blackbird, very similar to Great-tailed Grackle but smaller. Male is darker black with less obvious glossiness (but still some, usually greenish); female is very similar to female Great-tailed but paler below.

name: Luapula Cisticola
rangeDescription: Northern and northeastern namibia, eastern angola, southeastern democratic republic of the congo, zambia (except northeastern), northern botswana, and northwestern zimbabwe
description: Relatively colorful, mid-sized, long-tailed cisticola. Note the brown back with thick black streaks, rufous on the wing and cap, and pale underparts.

name: Papuan Thornbill
rangeDescription: New guinea (snow mountains to owen stanley range)
description: A small bird of upper montane and subalpine forest canopy and bushes. Dull brown upperparts, whitish underparts and yellowish tinged head, neck and upper chest.

name: Unicolored Thrush
rangeDescription: Northern bolivia (beni and santa cruz); rare and local
description: Drab thrush endemic to floodplain forest of the Río Mamoré and tributaries surrounded by the flooded Moxos grasslands in El Beni, central Bolivia. From similar Hauxwell’s and Black-billed Thrushes by dull olive bill, exposed yellowish orbital skin, and relatively plain throat.

name: Blanford's Rosefinch
rangeDescription: Coniferous forest of nepal to southeastern tibet and southwestern china
description: Attractive medium-sized finch of subalpine coniferous areas; may move down to upper foothills in the winter. Male is predominantly pinkish raspberry-red with a white vent and lower belly.

name: Halmahera Flowerpecker
rangeDescription: Moluccas (morotai, halmahera, kasiruta, bacan, obi, and bisa)
description: A tiny, dumpy, very short-tailed gray songbird. Paler underparts are divided by a whiter central strip.

name: Glow-throated Hummingbird
rangeDescription: Mountains of western panama (chiriquí and veraguas)
description: Tiny, poorly-known hummingbird with extremely limited range in western Panama. Males are greenish above with rusty flanks, a pinkish-red throat, and a white collar.

name: Tufted Titmouse
rangeDescription: South-central canada (ontario) to eastern, central, and southeastern usa
description: Common backyard bird in the eastern U.S. Look for its overall gray plumage with paler underparts and orangey sides.
